title: The Farewell Sidecar Posted Two Days Before New Year's Eve
conflicts: Total funding: about $35m (Fortune, PCWorld, AFP/CB Insights, Dec 2015) vs $39m (Bloomberg via Fortune and TechCrunch, Jan 2016): story says 'under 40 million'. GM price undisclosed (Bloomberg source: less than $39m; an Automotive News estimate of $39m): story says undisclosed and less than raised.
notes: Blame for the defeat is given only in Paul's own words (2018 Recode column). The 2018 antitrust suit by SC Innovations against Uber, allowed to proceed in May 2020, is recorded in research_notes but left out of the story because its final outcome was not confirmed. Medium original is cited through an Internet Archive copy from the day of posting, as medium.com blocks automated requests. No layoff count was found. Quote stance: complicates.
